_provenance: Demonstration design case used to produce Report_Before.pdf and Report_After.pdf. The repository contains no real project file (.osi) and examples/plate_girder/*.yaml are placeholders. Span 30 m is taken from examples/plate_girder/example_basic.yaml; 7.5 m carriageway is the IRC two-lane carriageway; skew 0 deg; location = a station from the bundled weather database. Every other input (vehicles, materials, girder layout, design options) is the OsdagBridge GUI default. Replace this file with a real project's values before using the report for engineering decisions.

report_metadata.comments: Demonstration input (GUI defaults, 30 m span, 7.5 m carriageway) - not a real project.
